metadata.dataset: NOAA GML atmospheric CO2 monthly data

columns.decimal_date: Date expressed as a decimal year.
columns.monthly_average: Monthly mean CO2 value, constructed from daily mean values.
columns.deseasonalized: Monthly value with the average seasonal cycle removed.
columns.number_of_days: Number of days contributing to the monthly value.
columns.standard_deviation: Standard deviation for the monthly mean.

source_notes: Data from March 1958 through April 1974 were obtained by C. David Keeling of the Scripps Institution of Oceanography (SIO) from the Scripps website.
Monthly mean CO2 is constructed from daily mean values.
Monthly values are corrected to the center of the month based on the average seasonal cycle.
Missing days can be asymmetric, which can produce a high or low bias.
Missing months have been interpolated. For NOAA data, these are indicated by negative standard deviation and uncertainty values.
For SIO data, Ndays, standard deviation, and uncertainty information is unavailable, so negative numbers are used for those fields as well.
Due to the Mauna Loa Volcano eruption, measurements from Mauna Loa Observatory were suspended on November 29, 2022 and resumed in July 2023.
Observations from December 2022 through July 4, 2023 were taken at the Maunakea Observatories, approximately 21 miles north of the Mauna Loa Observatory.
Numeric sentinel values from the source (for example, -1 and -9.99) are preserved as supplied; they have not been converted to null.
metadata.measurement_unit: Not explicitly stated in the supplied text file.
